patches.name: Share to audio server
patches.description: Adds 'Send to server' and 'Send to server (Kids)' to Android's share menu. Before patching, tap this patch's options (gear icon) and set the Server URL and API token; patching fails without them.

options.title: Server URL
options.description: Base URL of the audio server: http://<server-ip>:8080 at home, or the server's Tailscale address. Required.

options.title: API token
options.description: The value of AUDIOSERVER_TOKEN on the server. Required.
